theorems.name: Submission.cmc_fc_gs_aqf_liminf_le_seq
theorems.statement: ∀ (μ : Measure ℝ) (a b t : ℝ), t ∈ Ioo a b → liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * μ (Ioo (t - h) t)) (𝓝[>] 0) ≤ liminf (fun n : ℕ => ((n : ℝ≥0∞) + 1) * (μ.restrict (Icc a b)) (Ioo (t - 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) t)) atTop
